C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 590
Date. 23. 9. 16

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sept. 23rd 1916

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang on the 22nd inst sent a message to General Lu at Woosung inviting him to come to Shanghai to discuss some important matters. He received a reply that Lu was sick and unable to attend.

Secret movements of troops appear to be in progress. The garrisons at Sungkiang and Fongching are being gradually withdrawn to Shanghai and their planes being taken by Chekiang troops.

Up to and including the 17th inst about 1,850 Rebels have registered at the Repatriation Office. Since then however it is reported that about 500 other different parties have applied and as the members of these parties number about 20,000 persons, their applications will be difficult to deal with from a financial point of view. The investigation of claims is not yet completed.

About 80 rebels of the poorest class were wandering around the Pahsienjao district in Frenchtown on the night of the 21st having no money to get lodgings and were dispersed by the Police.

No settlement has yet been reached between the painters and their employers but several of the workmen unable to hold out any longer are dribbling back to work.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：R.H）

刑事侦缉处
情报官登记册
编号 590
日期. 16. 9. 23

（印章：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

上海工部局。

1916年9月23日

先生：

据报，杨将军于本月22日向吴淞的卢将军发出讯息，邀请其来沪商讨若干重要事宜。他收到回复称，卢将军因病无法出席。

似乎正在进行秘密的部队调动。松江和奉贤的驻军正逐渐撤往上海，其防地由浙江军队接管。

截至本月17日（含当日），约有1,850名叛军在遣返办公室登记。然而，此后据报另有约500个不同团体提出申请，由于这些团体的成员人数约为20,000人，从财政角度来看，处理他们的申请将十分困难。对索赔的调查尚未完成。

21日晚，约80名最贫困阶层的叛军在法租界八仙桥地区四处游荡，因无钱住宿，被警察驱散。

油漆工与其雇主之间尚未达成和解，但几名工人因无法再坚持，已零星返回工作岗位。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

总探长。

警务处总监。

（批注：R.H）
